# Native protocol foundation

The `schema/` files are unmodified standalone JSON schemas generated by the
locally installed stock `codex-cli 0.160.0` on 4 October 2026. Only the 22
contracts used by this bounded foundation are retained. Their sorted relative
paths (UTF-8, followed by a NUL) and exact file bytes form the SHA-256 inventory
checked by `TestSchemaInventory`.

The local macOS binary SHA-256 was
`112fae7a5a1223e673c8a1791d32338f37df8b527ff1159bb8adac6c4dbf1b4b`.
This is a local schema-generation observation, not a verified Linux artifact,
Sigstore verification, target-container protocol measurement, or model-access
test. #164 owns artifact verification; #34/#241 own independent conformance.

Generation used an empty temporary HOME and CODEX_HOME with an otherwise empty
environment. It read no human credential store, performed no subscription
sign-in and requested no model turn:

```sh
codex --version
codex app-server generate-json-schema --out <temporary-schema-directory>
```

The [official native protocol documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server)
describes version-specific schema generation and the bidirectional JSONL
transport. Generated schemas, rather than documentation examples, determine
field names and response variants here. The test messages are synthetic,
including errors, usage and approvals; they are not recorded live evidence.

D53 landed as `c6b28807eaf73a85676a81e9a8332b77d08549ee` before source edits.
Production launch remains unsupported while mandatory target configuration,
instruction isolation, child admission/cleanup, artifact and exact model/effort
gates are unmeasured. No exec fallback or token relay is provided.
